title: Supramolecular complexation of C60 and C70 by helical nanographene incorporating N-heterotriangulene and hexabenzocoronene subunits
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,3250-3258
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07837C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Marina Kinzelmann, Nina Fröhlich, Frederik Gnannt, Jan Borstelmann, Stefan Frühwald, Christoph Oleszak, Norbert Jux, Andreas Görling, Milan Kivala, Thomas Drewello
The host–guest chemistry of the double N-heterotriangulene-[5]helicene and C60,70 is reminiscent of a molecular helter skelter. The noncovalent nanographene–fullerene complexes are prime examples of concave–convex shape complementarity.
